title: User Registration with Valid Email
description: Verify that a new user can register successfully with a valid email and receives an email verification prompt.

steps.description: Navigate to the registration page.
Fill in the registration form with valid email, password, and required fields.
Submit the registration form.
Confirm receipt of an email verification prompt or message.
Verify that the account is created but not active until email is verified.

title: User Registration with Invalid Email
description: Test that registration fails with an invalid email format and appropriate error message is shown.

steps.description: Navigate to the registration page.
Fill the registration form using an invalid email format.
Submit the registration form.
Check that registration is blocked with a specific invalid email format message.

title: User Sign In with Correct Credentials
description: Ensure that a registered user can sign in successfully with correct credentials.

steps.description: Navigate to the sign-in page.
Enter valid registered email and password.
Click the sign-in button.
Verify successful authentication and redirect to user dashboard.

title: User Sign In with Incorrect Credentials
description: Verify that sign in fails with incorrect password and displays an error message.

steps.description: Navigate to the sign-in page.
Enter registered email with incorrect password.
Click the sign-in button.
Verify that sign-in is unsuccessful with an authentication error message.

title: Protected Route Access Prevention for Unauthenticated User
description: Verify that non-authenticated users cannot access protected routes like dashboard or profile pages.

steps.description: Attempt to navigate to the dashboard URL without logging in.
Ensure the system redirects to the sign-in page or shows an access denied message.

title: Profile Information Update and Avatar Upload
description: Verify that authenticated users can update profile data and upload an avatar successfully.

steps.description: Log in as an authenticated user and navigate to the profile management page.
Update personal information fields.
Upload a valid avatar image file.
Save the profile changes.
Verify saved changes persist and avatar is displayed correctly.

title: Resume Creation through Multi-Tab Form
description: Verify that users can create a new resume by entering data through each tab (Personal Info, Summary, Experience, Education, Skills) with real-time validation.

steps.description: Log in and navigate to the resume builder page.
Fill in the Personal Info tab with valid data and verify validation messages are absent.
Complete other tabs (Summary, Experience, Education, Skills) with valid input.
Verify the real-time preview updates immediately reflecting entered data without errors.
Try entering invalid data (e.g. missing required fields) to test client-side validation.
Verify that validation messages appear and prevent progress/save until corrected.

title: Switch Between Resume Templates
description: Verify that users can switch between multiple professional resume templates and the preview updates accordingly with preserved user input.

steps.description: Create or open an existing resume in the builder.
Select each available template from the gallery or template selector.
Confirm that the real-time preview reflects the selected template style visibly.
Verify that all entered resume data remains intact when switching templates.

title: Auto-save Resume Data after Input Changes
description: Check that the resume builder auto-saves resume data as user enters or updates information, without explicit save action.

steps.description: Open resume builder and enter data in at least two tabs.
Wait for auto-save to trigger or simulate blur event.
Reload the builder page and load the same resume.
Verify that previously entered data is retrieved and displayed correctly.

title: Create, Update, and Delete Resumes in Dashboard
description: Test full CRUD operations for resumes from the user dashboard with appropriate RLS enforcement to ensure data isolation.

steps.description: Log in and navigate to the dashboard.
Create a new resume and populate required fields.
Verify the new resume is listed in the dashboard resume list.
Edit the resume, changing some fields, and save.
Verify updates are persisted and reflected in dashboard and builder.
Delete the resume from the dashboard.
Verify the resume is removed from the list and no longer accessible.
Confirm other users cannot access this resume (RLS enforcement test).

title: PDF Export Maintains Template Styling
description: Ensure the exported PDF preserves all selected template styling, formatting, and content accurately.

steps.description: Complete a resume using any supported template.
Trigger the PDF export action.
Verify the generated PDF file contains all resume content with formatting matching the selected template.
Open the PDF on multiple devices/viewers to confirm consistent styling.

title: Real-time Preview Synchronization with Input
description: Verify that as the user inputs data in the resume form, the real-time preview panel updates immediately and correctly without lag or errors.

steps.description: Open the resume builder and navigate to any data input tab.
Enter or modify key fields such as name, job titles, skills.
Check the resume preview updates in real-time reflecting the exact changes.
Try rapid input changes and deletions to test responsiveness.
Confirm no data loss or preview desynchronization occurs.

title: Responsive Design and UI on Various Devices
description: Verify that the application UI including the resume builder, dashboard, and templates gallery display correctly without UI breakage on mobile, tablet, and desktop screen sizes.

steps.description: Access the application using devices/emulators with screen sizes for mobile, tablet, and desktop.
Verify that navigation menus, forms, previews, and buttons are usable and visually consistent.
Ensure no element overlaps, truncation, or horizontal scrolling occurs.
Test orientation changes (portrait/landscape) on mobile devices.
Verify UI adapts appropriately and remains usable.

title: Blog System Article Browsing and Sidebar Navigation
description: Ensure that non-authenticated users can browse blog articles and use the sidebar navigation without authentication.

steps.description: Access the blog page as a non-authenticated user.
Click on different blog cards to view articles.
Verify articles load correctly with proper content.
Use the sidebar navigation to move between article categories or tags.
Confirm navigation updates the displayed content accordingly.

title: Security: XSS and CSRF Attack Prevention
description: Validate that user inputs and API endpoints are protected against XSS and CSRF attacks effectively.

steps.description: Attempt to enter malicious scripts or HTML tags in form inputs like resume fields and profile information.
Perform form submissions with CSRF attack simulation (e.g. forged requests).
Verify that inputs are sanitized and scripts are not executed in the application.
Confirm the application rejects or blocks CSRF attempts and maintains secure session handling.

title: Session Management and Token Refresh
description: Test that user sessions are handled securely with automatic token refresh and expire correctly on logout or inactivity.

steps.description: Log in to the application and remain idle to simulate session expiry.
Confirm token refresh mechanism triggers without user disruption.
Manually log out.
Verify session tokens are invalidated and protected routes reject access.
Check no sensitive data remains accessible in session storage or cookies.

title: Multiple Resumes Management Per User
description: Verify that authenticated users can create, save, switch among, and delete multiple resumes while maintaining proper isolation and data integrity.

steps.description: Log in and create at least two different resumes.
Switch between resumes in the dashboard or builder.
Verify that each resume loads its corresponding data correctly in the builder and preview.
Delete one resume.
Confirm the deleted resume is removed and other resumes remain accessible.

title: Form Validation on Backend Storage
description: Test that resume data saved to backend meets validation requirements and invalid data is rejected appropriately.

steps.description: Attempt to submit or save resumes containing invalid data (e.g., missing required fields, invalid date ranges).
Verify backend validation responds with errors and prevents invalid data persistence.
Submit a valid resume.
Confirm backend accepts the data and saves it successfully.
